proof_body:
by
  intro R S _ _ _ _ P₁ P₂ Q₁ hP₂ _ hQ hle
  obtain ⟨Q₂, hge, hprime, hcomap⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral P₂ Q₁ (hQ ▸ hle)
  exact ⟨Q₂, hge, hprime, hcomap⟩
target_source: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (P₁ P₂ : Ideal R) (Q₁ : Ideal S), P₂.IsPrime → Q₁.IsPrime → Ideal.comap (algebraMap R S) Q₁ = P₁ → P₁ ≤ P₂ → ∃ Q₂ : Ideal S, Q₁ ≤ Q₂ ∧ Q₂.IsPrime ∧ Ideal.comap (algebraMap R S) Q₂ = P₂
